Changing the model restarts the agent. It comes back with nothing in its memory, and anything it was part way through ends, including anything it agreed to and has not done yet. Its instructions and its files are untouched.

    
Moving it to another account takes everything it has done with it. Moving is how you take an agent off an account that is running out.

Skills

      

        Ways of working you hand this agent beyond its instructions: how to
        summarise, how to file an expense, how your team writes minutes. It
        reads them when it starts, so anything you add here arrives at its
        next restart.

                Connections
                
    
    
    
                Checking what is connected…
                
    
                
      Below are the other services your agents will reach: where your code
      lives, where your team talks, where your tasks are. They open up here
      one at a time, starting with task boards.
    
                
    
                
      When one opens up, you sign in on the service’s own page and this Mac
      holds the key. Kosmos never sees a password.
    
                
    
                What agents touch every day
                
      
                
        Tasks and issuesBeing built first
        
                
          
                Kosmos gives you a simple task list to start with, and it is the one on your projects. Connecting a board you already use means your tasks stay where they are: Kosmos reads them and does not copy them, so nothing here can disagree with your board. Trello is the one being built first.

                Global skills
                
      
                
        Skills every agent on this Mac gets, alongside whatever each one has
        of its own. Agents read them when they start, so anything you add
        arrives at each agent’s next restart.

                AI policies
                
      
      
                
        If your company has rules for how AI gets used, put them here and
        every agent on this Mac will follow them. Keep as many as you have,
        say one from Legal and one from Engineering; every agent gets all
        of them.
      
                
      
                
      
                
        
        
                Name it for whoever it comes from. Then paste a link to it, or paste the policy itself.
                
        
                
          
        
                
        
        
                We fetch the page and hand its words to your agents. Your agents never visit the site themselves.
                
        
                
          
          
        
                
        
        
        
                
          
          
        
                
      
                
      
                
    
                
  
                
  
                
    
                
      
      
                Agents talking to each other
                
      
                
        
                Limit how often your agents message each other
          
                Every message between your agents is billed to your AI plan. Past the limit below, Kosmos stops them for the rest of the hour. If your model does not charge per use, turn this off.
                
        
      
                
      
                
        
        
        exchanges an hour
      
                
      
                A hundred exchanges an hour can add up if your provider charges per use.
                
      
                Your agents will keep talking as long as they have something to say. Kosmos will still tell you when a conversation stops going anywhere, but it will not step in.

                Keeping agents running
                
      
                Checking this computer…
                
      
                
      
      
                
      
      
                Kosmos runs in the background. Closing this window does not stop your agents.
                
    
                
      
      
                If your Mac asks about “tmux”
                
      
                
        Sometimes macOS shows a box like “tmux” would like to access
        files in your Desktop folder. tmux is the window Kosmos runs your
        agents in, so that is an agent asking to reach a folder you gave it
        work in. Allow it and the agent can do what you asked; Don’t Allow
        quietly stops that one job. Kosmos never reaches outside its own
        folders unless you ask an agent to.
      
                
    
                
    
                
      
                Agents already on this computer
                
      
      
                
        Kosmos keeps looking for Claude agents made outside it. Any it finds
        are listed at the bottom of the Agents page, with a button to bring
        each one in.
      
                
      
      
                
    
                
    
                
  
                
  
                
    
                
      
      
                Updates
                
      
      
                
        
                
          
                
        
      
                
      
      
      
                
        
                Let the Kosmos team know when you create an agent
          
                One small message each time: that an agent was made, when, which Kosmos version and which macOS, and a random ID for this install, so we can count how many people use Kosmos. Nothing about the agent, and nothing it does.
                
        
      
                
      
                
      
      
                
        
                Let the Kosmos team know when an agent posts or answers you
          
                Off by default. One small message each time: which agent, whether it posted or answered, which project, when, and a random ID for this install. Never the words. This is what a phone notification will ride on once Kosmos can reach your phone.
                
        
      
                
      
                

      
                
        
                Update Kosmos automatically
          
                On by default. New versions install themselves, which takes a few seconds and reloads this board. Agents keep running throughout.
                
        
      
                
      
                
    
                
  
                
  
  
                
    
                Plus Account
                
    
                Use your Kosmos from anywhere.
                

    
                
      
                Plus connects this Mac to your phone and your other computers:
      open your board from anywhere, get a notification when an agent
      posts or needs you, and everything you have stays on this Mac. The
      connection is end-to-end encrypted, and the service cannot read
      what passes through it.
                
      
      
                Every phone and computer asks this Mac before it gets in, and you
      can take any of them back here at any time.
                
      
                Sign-up is not open yet. When it opens, this is where it
      happens: your email, a code to confirm it, and this Mac gets an
      address of its own. Nothing to configure on your router. Plus will
      be a monthly subscription; the price is not set yet.
                
    
                

    
                
      
                
        
                
          
                Use Kosmos from anywhere
                
          
                
        
                
        
      
                
      
                
        
                
          
          
        
                
        
                
          
        
                
        
                
        
                
          
                
            
            
          
                
          
                
            
            
                3 to 32 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
                
            
          
                
          
                
            
          
                
        
                
      
                
      
      
                
        
                Devices that can reach this Mac
                
        
                Each one asked here first. Remove one and it stops right away; it can ask again by signing in.
                
        
                Plus is off, so nothing can reach this Mac right now. Your devices are kept for when you turn it back on.
                
        
                
        
                None yet. The first time you sign in from a phone, it asks here.
                
        
                
      
                
      
      
                
        
                I lost my phone
                
        
                Signing in from a phone asks for a second code after the email code. If the phone that gives that code is gone, this Mac can switch the second step off. Nobody else can, not even us. Sign in from your new phone afterwards and set it up again there.

                Changes apply as soon as you pick one.
                
    
                

    
                
      
      
                Ask one of your agents to write you a style file:
      lines of --name: value;, one color or size per line.
      Paste it here and it applies on top of the theme, in light and dark
      alike.
                
      
      
                
        
        
      
                
      
                
    
                
  
                

  
                
    
                
      
      
                Engineering mode
                
      
                
        
                Show agents' windows on project pages
          
          
                Off by default. A project page can show several agents at once, and their raw sessions crowd it. Each agent's own page always shows its window.
                
        
      
                
      
                
    
                

  
                
    
                
      Delete your history
      
      
                
        Deletes every conversation, and what each agent last reported it was
        working on. Your projects, your tasks, your agents and everything they
        have written are untouched.
        This one cannot be undone, unlike removing an agent.
      
                
      
                
    
                
    
  
                
  
  
                
    
                
      The working rules
      
                
        Agents made before the current working rules can have them added,
        with your OK, under their own heading. Your own words in each
        agent’s instructions are never touched.
